note: Desired state for macOS system daemons on every glaeda macOS host: none of these holds hot_cores for longer than hot_hours. scripts/glaeda-daemon-heal (a root LaunchDaemon) converges to it by restarting the daemon (launchd starts a fresh one); glaeda-mini-health keeps that LaunchDaemon installed and reports what it sees. A daemon with wait_idle waits for an idle host (no process named in busy) until busy_hot_hours. Seen 10-20: fseventsd at 1.0-1.7 cores for days with 13-30 GiB RSS on cmux 3/7/9/11/12/13/14 (a restart on idle cmux9 took it from 100% / 27 GiB to 1.5% / 4 MiB); audiomxd and WirelessRadioManagerd at 1.0-1.1 cores on headless aws-m4pro-5..9.
